invariants.rationale: The method returns 1 if wrap is false, or a possibly greater value if wrap is true, but never less than 1.
If wrap is false, result is 1; if true, result is columnSizes.size >> 1.
If wrap is not enabled, the result is always 1.
If wrap is enabled, result is columnSizes.size >> 1.
Shift-right by 1 yields a value no greater than columnSizes.size if wrap is true; otherwise, result is 1.
